objective: Improve out-of-sample generalization by expanding real training text coverage, especially positive and neutral outcomes; do not relabel old test errors to inflate scores.
annotator: Same Codex assistant as v3; one AI annotator, no human consensus. Exact serving revision unavailable.
annotation_rubric: Same as v3: main reported outcome for the main affected subject/audience. Negative=evidenced harm/loss/deterioration/material risk; positive=evidenced benefit/recovery/improvement; neutral=no clear directional outcome. Factual style does not mean neutral. Exclude broken extracts and substantially ambiguous/mixed targets. Labels and rationales are written from exact inputs, with role/hint hidden in annotation batches and without candidate predictions.
collection: Target720 additional Wikinews title+lead inputs:480 assigned Train and240 assigned fresh Test before labels. Same1500-most-recent published-category pool per language, old360 pages excluded. Test120/language randomly sampled first; Train240/language uses120positive-title hints,60neutral-title hints, random fills. Hints only sample text; they never assign class. Actual counts after rights/extraction/group/annotation filters are recorded, not forced.
licenses: Same Wikinews CC BY2.5/4.0 scope and attribution; later contributions to older EN pages retain both terms. No images or quoted leads. Only source-language pages, no translations generated by this project; source translation history not audited. New annotation metadata CC0 to extent project rights apply.
split: Carry only the original244 v3 Train rows into expanded Train; original49 Val,49 Test and18 exclusions remain outside fitting. New Test is disjoint from all old360 inputs and their linked-page/shared-source/near-duplicate groups; new Train cannot connect to new Test or old360 groups. Near-duplicate threshold char4/5 TFIDF cosine>=.85. Label-based exclusions use same rubric before fitting. No post-score seed or split changes.
development: 3-fold StratifiedGroupKFold inside expanded Train only; stratum=language:label, group=source component, seed20261108. Within each fold, use nested seeded group subsets at1/3,2/3,1 of fit groups. Fit a clean frozen GPU baseline and a clean own GPU fine-tune for each size:18 CV runs. Same development fold for all three sizes. Report mean/SD macro-F1 and positive recall. CV is diagnostic; no hyperparameter search and the full-Train final recipe is fixed in advance.
recipe: Keep v3 max128, clean pinned multilingual MiniLM base e8f8c211226b894fcb81acc59f3b34ba3efd5f42, balanced C1 logistic frozen head; own fine-tune all encoder layers for3full epochs, batch32, encoder_lr2e-5/head_lr2e-4 AdamW weight_decay.01 warmup10%, inverse-class CE and clip1, BF16 autocast FP32 master. No Val stopping/selection. All final Train rows seen in each epoch. FP32 output and BF16 storage derivation share one new fit.
additional_model: C1 balanced word/bigram TFIDF min_df1 LinearSVC maxiter2000, fitted to same expanded Train without old colleague supplements.
test_policy: Freeze all final candidates after CV. Predict each fresh Test item once per candidate; reuse per-item checkpoints only to recover interruptions. Old v3 Test has been inspected diagnostically from saved predictions, not treated as fresh evidence. It is not evaluated again. Old244 artifacts are unchanged controls on the new common Test, with new MLflow evaluation runs; old run metrics remain immutable.
metrics: Accuracy, macro-F1, per-class F1, positive recall, negative recall, confusion matrices, per-language metrics and mean(DE_macro_F1,EN_macro_F1), inference_ms_per_text, model_size_bytes. Metrics are agreement with AI reference annotations. Main descriptive selection metric is mean-language macro-F1; within.005 prefer latency then size. Exploratory group-bootstrap intervals from saved predictions cover sampling variability, not annotation error.
latency: CUDA RTX5060Ti, CPUthreads4, batch1,20separate warmups, synchronize before/after each measured prediction; tokenizer/transfers included, downloads/load/network excluded. API paused for CV/final measurements; one GPU benchmark worker.
mlflow: article-sentiment-second-path; phase=wikinews-ai-v4-expanded; stage=cv or final-test; comparable_group identifies same fold/development set or same fresh final Test; label_source=AI-labelled/Codex-reviewed; human_gold=false; immutable split/protocol/annotation/artifact hashes and Git commit recorded. CV/model weights local models/, corpus inputs ignored.
data_effect_limits: Old244 versus expanded comparison changes quantity and enrichment/class coverage, not quantity alone. Nested CV sizes more directly examine scale under the expanded sampling distribution. More data is not guaranteed to improve performance; preserve negative findings. Public-source pretraining overlap and residual event overlap remain unknown.
deployment: Add expanded models as experimental choices, fresh comparison and CV learning curve on website; update source credits/licences/README. Retain Qwen serving default under existing policy: AI-only evidence is insufficient for an automatic production switch. Preserve all v1/v2/v3 artifacts, reports and MLflow runs; second-path only, main unchanged.
